objects.label: 16 New High-Capacity Sag Catch Basins at Top Flood Depressions
objects.notes: Adds 0.08 m3/s catch basins directly at the 16 deepest street ponding sags across Basins 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 21.

objects.label: Mission Creek / 15th & Folsom Permanent Pump Station (2.0 m3/s)
objects.notes: Pumps 2.0 m3/s of overland ponding from the 17th & Folsom / Mission Creek bowl ($113.9M baseline damage) directly to the Bay.

objects.label: Division & 7th/8th Street Permanent Pump Station (1.5 m3/s)
objects.notes: Extracts 1.5 m3/s from the Division/Townsend basin ($71.0M baseline damage), protecting buildings 10209, 10210, and 10212.

objects.label: Central SoMa 5th & Harrison Permanent Pump Station (1.2 m3/s)
objects.notes: Removes 1.2 m3/s from the Central SoMa freeway underpass and Perry/Clara/Harrison sag ($34.2M baseline damage).

objects.label: Mission Bay / King & 5th Street Permanent Pump Station (1.0 m3/s)
objects.notes: Pumps 1.0 m3/s out of the Mission Bay / Channel depression ($34.8M baseline damage), protecting residential towers 2782 and 2783.

objects.label: 3rd & Folsom (Basin 21) Dedicated Pump Station (0.6 m3/s)
objects.notes: Drains the closed sag at 2345, 2811 adjacent to Building 8642 ($28.7M #1 single-building loss in baseline).

objects.label: 17th & Folsom Underground Stormwater Storage Vault (1,500 m3)
objects.notes: Captures peak burst runoff at 3.0 m3/s at the centroid of Basin 1 between Buildings 574 and 3769.

objects.label: 26 Quad-Bank 12-inch Diesel Trailer Pump Stations (38.2 m3/s Total)
objects.notes: Deploys four 12-in centrifugal pumps (1.47 m3/s per site) at 26 critical ponding sags from T-2h through storm end.

objects.label: Folsom Street Bioretention Green Infrastructure Corridor (13th to 16th St)
objects.notes: 480 m x 3.0 m SFPUC bioretention swale (ksat 127 mm/h) intercepting sheet flow along Folsom St into Basin 1.

objects.label: Harrison Street Bioretention Green Infrastructure Corridor (13th to 15th St)
objects.notes: 310 m x 3.0 m bioretention swale capturing street runoff along Harrison St in the Mission Creek watershed.

objects.label: Embarcadero North Ferry Plaza Low Concrete Floodwall (1.1 m)
objects.notes: Prevents 2.82 m NAVD88 king tide + storm surge from overtopping the low Embarcadero promenade into Basin 5.

objects.label: 4th Street / Channel Underpass Deployable AquaFence Barrier (1.1 m)
objects.notes: Blocks Mission Creek Channel tidal surge and overland flow from pouring into the 4th St underpass sag.

objects.label: FEMA P-936 Dry Floodproofing (0.9 m) on 7 High-Value Buildings
objects.notes: Seals ground-floor walls, flood shields doorways, and installs backflow valves to 0.9 m on 7 critical buildings (20,924 m2).

objects.label: Flood-Zone Contents Elevation & Utility De-Energization Program
objects.spec: Citywide Flood Zone Contents Elevation & Ground-Floor De-Energization
objects.notes: Reduces contents flood damage by 35% (factor 0.65) across 4210 low-lying buildings via pre-storm elevation.

objects.label: SF Public Works Pre-Storm Sandbag Giveaway at 14 Hotspot Hubs (28,000 Bags)
objects.notes: Distributes 28,000 filled sandbags across 14 flood-basin sites, providing 0.3 m doorway protection to 1,400 nearby buildings.

objects.label: SFMTA Pre-Storm Flood-Zone Tow-Away Operations (Zone 1)
objects.notes: Suspends parking and tows vehicles out of deep ponding streets prior to T-6h to prevent vehicle floatation and flood total losses.

objects.label: DPW Mobile LED Light Towers Staged in SoMa & Mission Creek
objects.notes: Stages 6 Generac 8kW mobile light towers to illuminate night-time barrier, pump, and rescue operations.

objects.label: Mandatory Pre-Landfall Evacuation: Mission Creek / 17th & Folsom Core (T-6h)
objects.notes: Evacuates all residents in the deep 17th & Folsom ponding bowl 6 hours before storm start using cars and paratransit buses. (transport=auto; to shelters [8637, 10049, 9304, 8194, 7128, 1175])

objects.label: Mandatory Pre-Landfall Evacuation: Central SoMa & Division/Townsend Basins (T-5h)
objects.notes: Evacuates all residents in the Central SoMa and 7th/8th & Townsend flood basins 5 hours before landfall. (transport=auto; to shelters [8637, 10049, 9304, 8194, 7128, 1175])

objects.label: Mandatory Pre-Landfall Evacuation: Mission Bay & Channel Basin (T-5h)
objects.notes: Evacuates all residents in the low-lying Mission Bay and Channel corridor 5 hours before landfall. (transport=auto; to shelters [8637, 10049, 9304, 8194, 7128, 1175])

objects.label: Early Paratransit & Assisted Evacuation for Vulnerable Populations (T-7h)
objects.notes: Evacuates elderly and disabled residents across all low-lying SF neighborhoods at T-7h before any street flooding begins. (transport=auto; to shelters [8637, 10049, 9304, 8194, 7128, 1175])

objects.label: HSA Central Food Distribution Depot (1350, 2680)
objects.notes: High-ground food staging depot supplying shelf-stable MREs to all 6 congregate shelters.

objects.label: SFPUC Bottled Water Distribution Depot (1550, 2680)
objects.spec: SFPUC Emergency Drinking Water Depot (SoMa High Ground)
objects.notes: High-ground water staging depot supplying bottled drinking water to all 6 congregate shelters.

objects.label: HSA Shelter Food Resupply Convoy (6 Flatbed Trucks)
objects.notes: Continuous looping delivery of meals from the HSA Food Depot to all 6 shelters starting at T-8h.

objects.label: SFPUC Shelter Water Resupply Convoy (5 Water Trucks)
objects.notes: Continuous looping delivery of drinking water from the SFPUC Water Depot to all 6 shelters starting at T-8h.

objects.label: SFFD Swiftwater Rescue Boat Division Charlie (Mission Bay & Channel)
